correctness.rationale: For p<q, sigma(pq)=(p+1)(q+1), giving the exact local obstruction p=2 or q congruent to -1 modulo p. The exceptional count is O(x/log x): Brun--Titchmarsh controls p<=x^(1/3), while a prime-counting bound and a bounded reciprocal-prime sum control x^(1/3)<p<sqrt(x). Landau's semiprime asymptotic then yields relative density one.
